يحيين (form I)
# يَحْيَيْنَ (yaḥyayna) /jaħ.jaj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of حَيَّ (ḥayya) and حَيِيَ (ḥayiya)
# يُحْيَيْنَ (yuḥyayna) /juħ.jaj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of حَيَّ (ḥayya)
